entries.title: Isaiah 52:1
segments: ¶Awake, awake; put on thy strength, O Zion; put on thy beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city: for henceforth there shall no more come into thee the uncircumcised and the unclean.

words.text: : for henceforth there shall no more

entries.title: Isaiah 52:2
segments: Shake thyself from the dust; arise, [and] sit down, O Jerusalem: loose thyself from the bands of thy neck, O captive daughter of Zion.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:3
segments: For thus saith the LORD, Ye have sold yourselves for nought; and ye shall be redeemed without money.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:4
segments: For thus saith the Lord GOD, My people went down aforetime into Egypt to sojourn there; and the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:5
segments: Now therefore, what have I here, saith the LORD, that my people is taken away for nought? they that rule over them make them to howl, saith the LORD; and my name continually every day [is] blasphemed.

words.text: Now therefore, what have I here, saith
over them make them to howl

entries.title: Isaiah 52:6
segments: Therefore my people shall know my name: therefore [they shall know] in that day that I [am] he that doth speak: behold, [it is] I.

words.text: : therefore [they shall know] in that day
that I [am] he that doth speak

entries.title: Isaiah 52:7
segments: ¶How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!

words.text: of him that bringeth good tidings

entries.title: Isaiah 52:8
segments: Thy watchmen shall lift up the voice; with the voice together shall they sing: for they shall see eye to eye, when the LORD shall bring again Zion.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:9
segments: Break forth into joy, sing together, ye waste places of Jerusalem: for the LORD hath comforted his people, he hath redeemed Jerusalem.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:10
segments: The LORD hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:11
segments: Depart ye, depart ye, go ye out from thence, touch no unclean [thing]; go ye out of the midst of her; be ye clean, that bear the vessels of the LORD.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:12
segments: For ye shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight: for the LORD will go before you; and the God of Israel [will be] your rereward. {be...: Heb. gather you up}

words.text: For ye shall not go out

entries.title: Isaiah 52:13
segments: ¶Behold, my servant shall deal prudently, he shall be exalted and extolled, and be very high. {deal...: or, prosper}

entries.title: Isaiah 52:14
segments: As many were astonied at thee; his visage was so marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men:

entries.title: Isaiah 52:15
segments: So shall he sprinkle many nations; the kings shall shut their mouths at him: for [that] which had not been told them shall they see; and [that] which they had not heard shall they consider.

words.text: at him: for [that] which had not been told
; and [that] which they had not heard
